full_judgment: 3. Facts relevant for the disposal of this petition are that respondent Nos. 1-16 instituted Title Suit No. 34. of 1981 in the Court of the Subordinate Judge, Satkhira against the petitioner and 11 others for declaration of title to the suit land and confirmation of possession therein alleging, inter alia, that the plaintiffs acquired title to the suit land on the basis of settlement from the landlord Narendra Nath Laha by a registered patta dated 14th July, 1944 on payment of salami of Tk. 7,000/-, and at the rental of Tk.150/- in the benami of Khairul Alam and on the same day a kabuliyat was executed in favour of the landlord by the said Khairul Alam Khan. Since the date of settlement the plaintiffs have been in possession of the suit land. It is also alleged that the plaintiff No.1 obtained delivery of the registered patta from the concerned Sub-Registrar's Office. The suit land was put to auction sale by the Government and one Abdus Rashid and others purchased the suit land. The aforesaid benamder Khairul Alam Khan filed a suit for setting aside the auction sale which was decreed on compromise and the sale was set aside. The plaintiffs further alleged that during preparation of P.R.R. Khatian, at the initial stage the suit land was recorded in the name of the plaintiffs but in final record the suit land was recorded wrongly in the khas khatian and such wrong record has clouded the plaintiff's title.
